{{Top|leg}}
The '''Twin DF .9/B Medium Anti-Infantry Battery''' was a fixed emplacement [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] weapon. It was a four-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] high turret with twin [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blasters]] mounted on top. It was produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]].
